verdict.rationale: vLLM exposes an OpenAI-compatible API server (plus Anthropic Messages API and gRPC), which lets developers call it using standard OpenAI Python/JS client libraries rather than a vLLM-branded first-party client library; a community comment confirms this workflow in practice. Missing for 10: dedicated official vLLM Python/JS SDKs, explicit multi-language client documentation, and independent hands-on confirmation of JS client usage.
